payload.name: Recruiterflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recruiterflow helps users search and count candidates and jobs, resolve team members, companies, stages, and custom fields, inspect job pipelines, and review candidate activity timelines through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Recruiterflow 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索并统计候选人和职位、确定团队成员、公司、阶段和自定义字段、查看职位招聘流程，并检查候选人活动时间线。

payload.name: Reecopedia
payload.description: 带引文的欧盟纺织法规搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reecopedia searches the primary texts of EU textile sustainability law and returns the matching passages with their source file and page, so answers can be checked against the document instead of trusted. The corpus covers ESPR (Regulation (EU) 2024/1781), the Digital Product Passport, CSRD, CBAM, EU ETS, CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2) and the JRC preparatory studies for textiles. Typical workflows: ask a compliance question and get cited passages; browse a result list and open a full document page; walk the outline of a standard and jump to the section you need; locate an exact wording such as an article number inside one document. It never browses the open web and never writes the answer itself. When the retrieved passages match poorly it says so, and when the only match is a EUR-Lex national-transposition register card it warns that the date on that card is a notification date and not an entry into force. No account and no personal data are required.
payload.longDescription: Reecopedia 搜索欧盟纺织品可持续发展法规的原始文本，并返回匹配段落及其来源文件和页码，让你可以对照文件核查答案，而不是盲目信任。语料涵盖 ESPR（Regulation (EU) 2024/1781）、Digital Product Passport、CSRD、CBAM、EU ETS、CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2)，以及 JRC 纺织品预备研究。典型工作流包括：提出合规问题并获取带引文段落；浏览结果列表并打开完整文档页面；查看标准大纲并跳转到所需章节；在单份文件中定位某个确切措辞，例如条款编号。它不会浏览开放网络，也不会自行撰写答案。当检索到的段落匹配度较低时，它会如实说明；如果唯一匹配结果是 EUR-Lex 国家转置登记卡片，它会提醒你卡片上的日期是通知日期，而非生效日期。无需账户，也不需要个人数据。

payload.name: V7 Go (EU)
payload.description: 运行工作流并查询知识
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: V7 Go turns documents and unstructured data into structured, queryable information, right inside ChatGPT. Discover and configure workflows, run them over your documents to extract structured fields, search across your files, add documents to knowledge graphs, and query the resulting workflow and context graph data, so you get answers grounded in your own sources.
payload.longDescription: V7 Go 可在 ChatGPT 中将文档和非结构化数据转化为结构化、可查询的信息。你可以发现并配置工作流，在文档上运行工作流以提取结构化字段，搜索文件，将文档添加到知识图谱，并查询由此生成的工作流和上下文图数据，从而获得以你自己的资料为依据的答案。

payload.name: Onlinecomponents Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to OnlineComponents Search to explore the complete electronic components catalog by manufacturer, part number, or keyword. Retrieve current stock levels, pricing and quantity breaks, packaging options, ordering requirements, and lifecycle status. Ideal for engineers and buyers who need to find parts, compare alternatives, and check availability directly within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 OnlineComponents Search，按制造商、零件号或关键词探索完整的电子元件目录。获取当前库存水平、价格和数量阶梯、包装选项、订购要求及生命周期状态。适合需要在 ChatGPT 中寻找零件、比较替代品并检查供应情况的工程师和采购人员。

payload.name: SalesNow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and research company profiles, job postings, news, and other business information using SalesNow's company data. Use it to build sales prospect lists and prepare for customer meetings.
payload.longDescription: 使用 SalesNow 的公司数据搜索和研究公司简介、招聘信息、新闻及其他商业信息。利用这些信息建立销售潜在客户名单，并为客户会议做准备。

payload.name: Modem
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Modem groups customer feedback from chat, issue trackers, and support inboxes into topics, people, and companies. From ChatGPT you can search that graph in natural language ("What are customers saying about billing this month?"), run the Modem Agent, and update your workspace directly: reprioritize topics, merge duplicate companies or people, and keep customer records current. Connecting uses OAuth; search (data:read) and agent/write access (agent:invoke) are granted separately, and write tools act under your existing role in the Modem organization you authorize. Requires a Modem account.
payload.longDescription: Modem 会将聊天、问题跟踪器和支持收件箱中的客户反馈归纳到主题、人员和公司中。你可以通过 ChatGPT 用自然语言搜索这张关系图（例如“客户本月对账单有什么看法？”）、运行 Modem Agent，并直接更新工作空间：调整主题优先级、合并重复的公司或人员，以及保持客户记录最新。连接通过 OAuth 完成；搜索权限（data:read）和智能体／写入权限（agent:invoke）分别授予，写入工具会依照你在获授权 Modem 组织中的现有角色执行。需要 Modem 账户。

payload.name: POCKET CFO
payload.description: 经营咨询与业务全方位支持服务
payload.summaryOriginal: 経営相談ビジネスのトータルサポートサービス
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ご自分のビジネスそのまま相談できます。

「使える補助金ある？」　「今月の利益は？」　「財務状況は？」　「融資を受けたい」　など
——ポケットCFOに登録された実際の取引から集計して答えます。

業種・地域・規模から絞り込んだ補助金や融資の候補も確認できます。

数字には必ず出どころ（対象期間・件数・数え方）が付きます。推測した数字は返しません。
まだ扱っていないもの（現預金の残高など）は、扱っていないとお伝えします。

読み取り専用です。請求書の発行・支払い・データの書き換えはできません。
許可はいつでも取り消せます。
payload.longDescription:
您可以直接咨询自己的业务。

例如：“有什么可申请的补助金吗？”“本月利润是多少？”“财务状况如何？”“我想申请贷款。”系统会根据登记在 Pocket CFO 中的真实交易汇总并作答。

您还可以根据行业、地区和规模筛选补助金及贷款候选项目。

每个数字都会标明其来源（统计期间、笔数和计算方法）。不会返回推测得出的数字。
尚未支持的内容（例如现金和存款余额）会明确告知您暂不支持。

此工具为只读。无法开具发票、付款或改写数据。
您可以随时撤销授权。

payload.name: Heatseeker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Heatseeker helps marketing teams inspect ad experiments, imported campaign performance, audience research, and AI personas from their workspace. The app can find workspaces, retrieve experiment results, rank top ads, analyze cross-source evidence, and answer persona-aware marketing questions through ChatGPT so decisions are grounded in customer behavior.
payload.longDescription: Heatseeker 帮助营销团队检查广告实验、导入的活动表现、受众研究和工作区中的 AI 用户画像。应用可查找工作区、获取实验结果、排名高表现广告、分析跨来源证据，并通过 ChatGPT 回答结合用户画像的营销问题，让决策建立在客户行为之上。

payload.name: xMatix
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your xMatix organization to find business records, analyze data, run saved reports and dashboards, and search platform knowledge. With organization approval and the required user permissions, create or update records and manage metadata, layouts, workflows, scripts and integrations. Sign in with your xMatix account and choose the organizations to connect. An administrator must enable External Assistants; write and setup access require opt-in. Access depends on connection scopes, organization settings and the permissions enforced by xMatix. Authorized automation and integration operations can change records and contact configured external services. Enter integration credentials in the authenticated xMatix application, not in chat.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 xMatix 组织，以查找业务记录、分析数据、运行已保存的报告和仪表板，并搜索平台知识。获得组织批准并具备所需用户权限后，可以创建或更新记录，并管理元数据、布局、工作流、脚本和集成。使用 xMatix 账户登录并选择要连接的组织。管理员必须启用 External Assistants；写入和设置权限需要选择加入。访问权限取决于连接范围、组织设置及 xMatix 强制执行的权限。获授权的自动化和集成操作可能会更改记录并联系已配置的外部服务。请在经过身份验证的 xMatix 应用中输入集成凭据，不要在聊天中输入。

payload.name: Guest-Ready Score
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guest-Ready Score helps people set up, prepare, assess, improve and maintain properties used for short-term stays and paying guests. It is designed for Airbnb hosts, short-term rental owners, vacation rental operators, cottage and cabin owners, lake houses, beach houses, chalets, condos, apartments, guest houses, lodges, villas, ski properties, waterfront rentals, country homes, tiny homes, furnished rentals, holiday rentals and other guest accommodation.

The tool is relevant for people asking how to start an Airbnb, how to prepare a property for guests, what to buy or stock, what amenities to provide, how to improve guest reviews, how to create a better guest experience, how to check whether a property is ready to list, or how to benchmark an existing rental against strong hospitality standards.

The 12-question assessment reviews core areas of the guest stay, including arrival and check-in, beds and sleeping comfort, bathrooms, kitchen readiness, lighting, temperature and climate comfort, Wi-Fi, cleanliness, restocking, guest communication, safety and local information. It then provides a practical Guest-Ready Score to help identify what is already working well and where additional attention may improve the stay.

Use Guest-Ready Score for first-time setup, pre-opening checks, pre-arrival preparation, rental audits, hospitality reviews, property readiness checks, host checklists, Airbnb setup questions, STR checklists, vacation rental standards, guest-experience improvement and ongoing quality control.

payload.name: Tracxn MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tracxn MCP gives you access to the full Tracxn platform - companies, funding rounds, investors, M&A, cap tables, financials, and more - directly from your favorite AI assistant.

What you can do once connected:
- Search for companies by sector, geography, stage, or custom criteria
- Pull funding histories and investor profiles
- Track recent M&A, IPOs, and market activity
- Generate research reports grounded in real Tracxn data

payload.name: Clera
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clera helps company hiring teams search vetted candidates against a role, review recommendations, request introductions, track hiring progress, and manage roles, public company profiles and private contacts. Search results mask candidate names but retain professional history; semantic search may send search inputs to Azure. Role-based searches show advisory fit flags that do not block introductions. Detailed profiles can remain available after an earlier named share expires or is revoked, and professional free text may contain personal details. Introduction requests can send emails and submit applications to a connected hiring system. Feedback is sent through Slack with user and company identity. Private call logs retain caller identity, inputs and results without automatic expiry.

payload.name: Talentin AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Talentin helps recruiters and hiring teams work an entire sourcing pass inside ChatGPT: draft a job description from a rough hiring requirement, search the Talentin candidate database with a job description or plain-English brief, review compact candidate cards, open full work-history profiles, and run detailed match analyses that score one or several candidates against the role with requirement coverage, pros, cons, and a summary. Users can also paste a resume to get a recruiter-style fit analysis against a specific job description. Each user connects with their own Talentin API key, so all searches and analyses run against their own Talentin account and quota.

payload.name: AdsAgent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AdsAgent helps advertising operators inspect Meta performance, manage reusable launch templates, prepare campaign changes, and execute explicitly confirmed Meta advertising actions through ChatGPT. OAuth connects to the operator's own AdsAgent workspace; advertising delivery changes require explicit confirmation, and workspace templates and settings can be edited directly at the user's request. AdsAgent never asks for health, payment-card, government-ID, or biometric data.

payload.name: Atlas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Atlas is your AI contract agent. Unlimited e-sign is free, with no credit card required.

Draft an agreement in the conversation, or share a PDF or DOCX, and Atlas turns it into a signable document: it detects signature lines, dates, and fields, and works out who signs what. You get a review link, click Send, and signers get a clean signing page on any device with no account needed.

Ask things like "send this MSA to sarah@acme.com for signature," "who still hasn't signed?", "remind them," or "pull the payment terms from the signed contract." Repeat sends run from saved templates in one message.

Atlas is review-first: it prepares everything and a human approves before any signature request goes out. Every signed document includes a completion certificate and a full audit trail.

payload.name: AWS Data Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Data lake, analytics, and ETL workflows with S3 Tables, AWS Glue, and Athena. Covers managed Iceberg tables on S3 Tables, ingestion from JDBC databases, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, and DynamoDB, AWS Glue Data Catalog inventory and asset discovery, federated Athena queries, and vector storage and semantic search on Amazon S3 Vectors.
payload.longDescription: 使用 S3 Tables、AWS Glue 和 Athena 处理数据湖、分析和 ETL 工作流。涵盖 S3 Tables 上的托管 Iceberg 表，从 JDBC 数据库、Amazon Redshift、Snowflake、BigQuery 和 DynamoDB 摄取数据，AWS Glue Data Catalog 的目录清单及资产发现，Athena 联邦查询，以及 Amazon S3 Vectors 上的向量存储和语义搜索。

payload.name: ThoughtSpot Spotter
payload.description: 你的 AI 数据分析师
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: From everyday data questions to high-level strategic analyses, Spotter by ThoughtSpot helps business and data teams get answers and insights they can trust, validate, and act on, enabling everyone to use data to drive the business forward.
payload.longDescription: 从日常数据问题到高层战略分析，ThoughtSpot 的 Spotter 都能帮助业务和数据团队获取可信、可验证且可采取行动的答案与洞察，让每个人都能利用数据推动业务发展。

payload.name: Sigma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore, search, query your data, and build applications and dashboards in Sigma directly from the ChatGPT interface. You can search across your organization for relevant documents and elements, answer and iterate on complex data questions, and perform detailed analysis using natural language.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 界面中探索、搜索和查询数据，并在 Sigma 中构建应用和控制面板。你可以在组织内搜索相关文档和元素，回答并迭代复杂的数据问题，也可以使用自然语言进行详细分析。

payload.name: PostHog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PostHog gives your AI agent direct access to your product analytics, feature flags, experiments, error tracking, surveys, logs, and LLM analytics. Ask questions about your data, create insights, toggle feature flags, analyze errors, search docs, and more — all from chat.
payload.longDescription: PostHog 让您的 AI 智能体直接访问产品分析、功能开关、实验、错误跟踪、调查、日志和 LLM 分析。您可以询问数据、创建分析洞察、切换功能开关、分析错误、搜索文档等，所有操作都可在聊天中完成。

payload.name: Helium 10
payload.description: 访问你的 Helium 10 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access your Helium 10 data directly in ChatGPT for Amazon sellers and FBA brands. Query keyword and ASIN data, analyze PPC campaign performance and profitability, and extract insights from your listings and rank tracking.

Make Helium 10 a native part of your ChatGPT workflows without switching between dashboards or exporting files. Built for active e-commerce brands with real account data across Product Research, Ads, and Commerce.
payload.longDescription:
Amazon 卖家和 FBA 品牌可直接在 ChatGPT 中访问 Helium 10 数据。查询关键词和 ASIN 数据、分析 PPC 广告活动表现及盈利能力，并从商品列表和排名追踪中提取洞察。

无需在控制面板之间切换或导出文件，即可将 Helium 10 融入 ChatGPT 工作流程。专为拥有真实 Product Research、Ads 和 Commerce 账号数据的活跃电商品牌打造。

payload.name: Typeform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build forms, contact lists, and automations without leaving ChatGPT. Use natural language to analyze your form and survey data, create data-rich contact profiles, and build automations that turn your form respondents into customers. Typeform makes it easy to understand and act on your customer data—without switching tools.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可创建表单、联系人列表和自动化流程。使用自然语言分析表单和问卷数据、创建包含丰富信息的联系人档案，并构建将表单答卷者转化为客户的自动化流程。Typeform 让你无需切换工具，即可轻松理解并使用客户数据。

payload.name: Amplitude
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Amplitude workspace to search charts and dashboards, query metrics and experiment results, explore events and properties, and create or update charts, dashboards, and alerts — without leaving the conversation. Amplitude is the product intelligence platform teams use to understand user behavior, measure impact, and decide what to build next.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Amplitude 工作区，搜索图表和控制面板，查询指标和实验结果，探索事件及属性，并创建或更新图表、控制面板和告警，无需离开对话。Amplitude 是团队用来了解用户行为、衡量影响并决定下一步构建什么的产品智能平台。

payload.name: Blockscout Blockchain Data
payload.description: 查找并分析区块链数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Query live blockchain data across 90+ EVM-compatible blockchain networks directly in ChatGPT. Blockscout gives you instant access to wallet balances, transaction histories, token holdings, NFTs, smart contract source code, and contract ABIs, no API keys required.

Ask questions in plain English: "What tokens does this wallet hold?", "Show me recent transactions on this contract", or "Resolve this ENS name." Blockscout handles the lookup and returns structured, accurate on-chain data in seconds.
payload.longDescription:
直接在ChatGPT中查询90+个兼容EVM的区块链网络的实时数据。Blockscout让你即时获取钱包余额、交易历史、代币持仓、NFT、智能合约源代码和合约ABI，无需API密钥。

用日常英语提问：“这个钱包持有哪些代币？”“显示这个合约的近期交易”，或“解析这个ENS名称。”Blockscout负责查询，并在几秒内返回结构化、准确的链上数据。

payload.name: Mixpanel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Query and analyze your Mixpanel data directly in ChatGPT. Run segmentation, funnel, and retention analyses, explore your event taxonomy, manage Lexicon metadata, and resolve data quality issues - all without leaving your conversation.

With the Mixpanel MCP server connected, ChatGPT can reason about your product analytics alongside your code, documents, and decisions. Ask questions in plain language, drill into user behavior, and get answers grounded in your actual data.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中查询和分析你的 Mixpanel 数据。运行细分、漏斗和留存分析，探索事件分类，管理 Lexicon 元数据，并解决数据质量问题，全程无需离开对话。

连接 Mixpanel MCP 服务器后，ChatGPT 可以结合代码、文档和决策来推理产品分析。用自然语言提问、深入了解用户行为，并获得基于真实数据的答案。

payload.name: Waldo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Waldo helps users research brands, advertising, social conversations, trends, and captured workspace intelligence by combining specialized skills with external data and authenticated workspace context.
payload.longDescription: Waldo 结合专业技能、外部数据和经过身份验证的工作区上下文，帮助用户研究品牌、广告、社交讨论、趋势以及已捕获的工作区情报。

payload.name: Serpstat
payload.description: SEO 数据与关键词研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build semantic keyword clusters, discover untapped market niches from 1000+ categories, and conduct comprehensive competitor analysis. Examine rival SEO strategies through their keyword portfolios, backlink profiles, top-performing pages, and ranking dynamics. Track domain positions across regions, audit technical site issues, identify content gaps, and evaluate keyword opportunities with volume and difficulty metrics. Claude navigates these capabilities naturally — combining data from multiple sources, validating SEO hypotheses in real-time, and building comprehensive strategies through interactive dialogue.
payload.longDescription: 构建语义关键词集群，从 1000+ 个类别中发现尚未开发的细分市场，并全面分析竞争对手。通过竞争对手的关键词组合、反向链接资料、表现最佳页面和排名动态，研究其 SEO 策略。追踪各地区的域名搜索排名位置、审核网站技术问题、发现内容差距，并根据搜索量和难度指标评估关键词机会。Claude 可以自然地运用这些功能，将多个数据源结合起来、实时验证 SEO 假设，并通过互动对话制定全面策略。

payload.name: BlazeSQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BlazeSQL lets ChatGPT and Codex query your database or warehouse with all the necessary context to get the correct answers.

Connect to Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Athena, MariaDB, SQL Anywhere, Databricks, Clickhouse, and Oracle.

With context management, observability, and comprehensive access controls, BlazeSQL turns ChatGPT or Codex into an enterprise-ready AI Data Analyst for reliable self-service across your entire company.

As a comprehensive Business Intelligence layer, BlazeSQL also enables visualization, dashboards, advanced statistical analysis, predictive analytics, scheduled reports, and custom PDF or interactive HTML reports.
payload.longDescription:
BlazeSQL 让 ChatGPT 和 Codex 查询你的数据库或数据仓库，并提供获得正确答案所需的全部上下文。

连接 Snowflake、BigQuery、Redshift、Microsoft SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、AWS Athena、MariaDB、SQL Anywhere、Databricks、Clickhouse 和 Oracle。

借助上下文管理、可观测性和全面的访问控制，BlazeSQL 将 ChatGPT 或 Codex 转变为满足企业要求的 AI 数据分析师，在整个公司范围内提供可靠的自助服务。

作为全面的商业智能层，BlazeSQL 还支持可视化、控制面板、高级统计分析、预测分析、定期报告，以及自定义 PDF 或交互式 HTML 报告。

payload.name: Tableau (MCP only; EOL soon)
payload.description: Tableau（仅 MCP；即将结束生命周期）
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This MCP based plugin will be deprecated shortly, please switch usage to the new Tableau Plugin.
payload.longDescription: 此基于 MCP 的插件即将停用，请改用新的 Tableau Plugin。

payload.name: Hex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answer data questions and spin up new analyses with the Hex Agent.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Hex Agent 解答数据问题，并开展新的分析。

payload.name: Trellis Law
payload.description: 美国州级初审法院研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Direct access to the US state trial court system, enabling legal research and insights on cases, verdicts, judges, attorneys, motions, litigation trends, and more - all grounded and sourced from trial court data and documents.
payload.longDescription: 直接访问美国州级初审法院系统，开展法律研究并获取有关案件、裁决、法官、律师、动议、诉讼趋势等方面的洞见；所有内容均以初审法院数据和文件为依据并附有来源。

payload.name: CData Connect AI
payload.description: 无需查询即可获得答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement. In Connect AI, you build virtual datasets across sources with defined relationships and semantic context, and surface them as purpose-built tools – so ChatGPT works with your data the way your business understands it, not just the way it’s stored. IT admins control access and monitor every query with full audit trails — so the right people reach the right data, nothing more.
payload.longDescription: Connect AI 可连接云数据仓库、关系数据库、数据湖仓、分析平台等，让您通过对话探索和分析数据。将数据用于 ChatGPT 中的工作，例如关联产品遥测与发布日程以调查用户参与度。在 Connect AI 中，您可以跨来源构建具有明确关系和语义上下文的虚拟数据集，并将其呈现为专用工具，让 ChatGPT 按企业理解数据的方式工作，而不只是按数据存储方式工作。IT 管理员控制访问权限，并通过完整审计跟踪监控每次查询，确保合适的人访问合适的数据。

payload.name: MotherDuck
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect AI assistants to your MotherDuck data warehouse. Explore, visualize, and manage data using natural language–no SQL skills required. Create Dives: interactive visualizations that let you save and share answers with your team, staying up-to-date with your latest data. Works with real-world data without requiring semantic models or pre-configuration. Your AI assistant acts like a data analyst, exploring, validating, analyzing, and visualizing data iteratively to answer your questions.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 助手连接到 MotherDuck 数据仓库。使用自然语言浏览、可视化和管理数据，无需 SQL 技能。创建 Dives：可交互的可视化内容，让你保存并与团队共享答案，同时保持最新数据同步。无需语义模型或预配置，即可处理真实世界的数据。你的 AI 助手会像数据分析师一样迭代探索、验证、分析和可视化数据，从而回答问题。

payload.name: StatsHawk
payload.description: 体育数据、球员道具投注与对阵分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StatsHawk gives ChatGPT real, current sports data instead of guesses from training data. Ask about any game and get scores, schedules, standings, box scores, rosters, and player lookups across NBA, WNBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, KBO, NCAA basketball and football, and major soccer competitions including the Premier League, all normalized into one consistent shape, with numbers landing within minutes of box scores posting.

Beyond the basics: MLB pitch-by-pitch with Statcast detail (pitch type, velocity, launch data, filterable to a batter-pitcher matchup) and pre-computed player prop analysis, season, recent, and home/away averages with hit rates against any line, built for fantasy research, start/sit calls, and matchup prep.

Sign in with a free StatsHawk account when you connect; no API key to manage. Free includes 5,000 usage credits monthly and every standard stat tool. Prop analysis comes with paid plans.
payload.longDescription:
StatsHawk 为 ChatGPT 提供真实、最新的体育数据，而不是训练数据中的猜测。你可以询问任意比赛，并获取比分、赛程、排名、比赛数据表、球队名单和球员查询，覆盖 NBA、WNBA、MLB、NFL、NHL、KBO、NCAA 篮球和橄榄球，以及包括 Premier League 在内的主要足球赛事。所有数据都经过统一规范，更新时间距离比赛数据表发布仅几分钟。

除基础功能外，还包括 MLB 逐球数据及 Statcast 详情（球种、球速、击球初速和角度数据，可按击球手与投手对阵筛选），以及预先计算的球员道具投注分析、赛季/近期/主客场平均值和针对任意盘口的命中率，适合幻想体育研究、先发/替补选择和对阵准备。

连接时使用免费的 StatsHawk 账户登录；无需管理 API 密钥。免费账户每月包含 5,000 个使用积分和所有标准统计工具。球员道具分析需使用付费套餐。

payload.name: GIS Cloud
payload.description: 创建地图并进行 GIS 分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GIS Cloud is a cloud geospatial platform used by governments, utilities, and field teams in 60+ countries. 

This app lets you work with your GIS Cloud account in plain language, no GIS expertise or clicking through menus required.

Ask ChatGPT to build and edit maps, create and style layers, add or query features, run spatial analysis, design mobile data collection forms for field teams, import datasets, and generate reports. It covers the full GIS workflow, from field capture to mapping, analysis, and reporting.

What you can do:
- Create, update, and organize maps and layers
- Add, edit, and query features and attribute data
- Run spatial analysis and compute statistics on your data
- Build and manage Mobile Data Collection forms for field teams
- Import files and manage datasets
- Generate reports from your geospatial data

You stay in control. GIS Cloud uses a propose-and-confirm model: changes are proposed before anything is written to your account, and destructive actions are clearly flagged. Access is scoped to your account through secure OAuth, with read-only operations separated from writes.

Works with your existing GIS Cloud account. New to GIS Cloud? Sign up free at giscloud.com.
payload.longDescription:
GIS Cloud 是一款云端地理空间平台，供 60 多个国家的政府、公用事业单位和外勤团队使用。

此应用让你可以用日常语言操作自己的 GIS Cloud 账户，无需 GIS 专业知识，也不必在菜单中反复点击。

让 ChatGPT 创建和编辑地图、创建并设置图层样式、添加或查询要素、运行空间分析、为外勤团队设计移动数据采集表单、导入数据集并生成报告。它覆盖完整 GIS 工作流程，从外勤采集到制图、分析和报告。

你可以：
- 创建、更新和整理地图及图层
- 添加、编辑和查询要素及属性数据
- 对数据运行空间分析并计算统计数据
- 为外勤团队创建和管理移动数据采集表单
- 导入文件并管理数据集
- 根据地理空间数据生成报告

由你掌控操作。GIS Cloud 采用“提出并确认”模式：在写入账户前会先提出变更，并明确标记具有破坏性的操作。访问权限通过安全的 OAuth 限定在你的账户范围内，只读操作与写入操作相互区分。

可与现有 GIS Cloud 账户配合使用。还没有 GIS Cloud 账户？可在 giscloud.com 免费注册。

payload.name: Powerset Research
payload.description: 访问 Powerset Research 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Powerset Research (https://research.powerset.co/) is a technical journal from Powerset (https://powerset.co/) where we analyze tech trends, publish analytics, and provide free tools for helping founders. This app allows anyone to access the data underlying Powerset Research via ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Powerset Research（https://research.powerset.co/）是 Powerset（https://powerset.co/）的技术期刊，分析科技趋势、发布分析报告，并提供帮助创业者的免费工具。此应用让任何人都能通过 ChatGPT 访问 Powerset Research 的底层数据。

payload.name: Similarweb
payload.description: 网站、应用、搜索和市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research any website or app inside ChatGPT using Similarweb's market intelligence data. Analyze competitor traffic, uncover top keywords, explore audience demographics, and benchmark performance across industries—all through simple prompts. Ask things like "Show me Nike's traffic sources breakdown" or "What keywords is Adidas ranking for?" and get real-time insights without switching tools. Whether you're a marketer, analyst, investor, or strategist, Similarweb helps you turn competitive questions into answers instantly.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Similarweb 的市场情报数据研究任意网站或应用。分析竞争对手流量、发现热门关键词、探索受众人口统计特征，并跨行业对比表现——只需输入简单提示。你可以询问“展示 Nike 的流量来源细分”或“Adidas 排名靠前的关键词有哪些？”，无需切换工具即可获取实时洞察。无论你是营销人员、分析师、投资者还是策略师，Similarweb 都能帮你即时将竞争问题转化为答案。

payload.name: Kwater
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Official real-time water data service by K-water (Korea Water Resources Corporation). Ask about dam storage levels, inflow/discharge, river water levels, rainfall, and water quality across South Korea's dams and rivers — updated every 10 minutes.
payload.longDescription: K-water（韩国水资源公社）提供的官方实时水资源数据服务。可查询韩国各地水坝和河流的蓄水量、入流量/出流量、水位、降雨量和水质；数据每 10 分钟更新一次。

payload.name: Metorik
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chat with your Shopify or WooCommerce sales data directly in ChatGPT. Ask questions like "Where do our most profitable customers come from?" or "Which products are trending this quarter?" and get real-time answers pulled straight from your store.

Dig into revenue, products, customers, and channels, or ask for a growth strategy built on your actual historical data. Works with one store or many, with every metric generated in real-time.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中对话，查询 Shopify 或 WooCommerce 销售数据。你可以提出诸如“我们最赚钱的客户来自哪里？”或“本季度哪些产品最热门？”等问题，并获得直接从店铺实时提取的答案。

深入了解收入、产品、客户和渠道，也可以根据实际历史数据询问增长策略。支持一个或多个店铺，所有指标均实时生成。

payload.name: Porter Metrics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Porter brings your marketing and ecommerce data into ChatGPT. Connect accounts from Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, GA4, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other supported platforms in Porter, then ask questions in plain English — "Which campaigns drove the most revenue last week?", "How did spend compare across channels yesterday?" — and get answers pulled live from your authorized accounts.

Compare performance across platforms using unified metrics like clicks and spend, even when the underlying numbers come from different sources.

When you need the data outside the chat, schedule recurring exports of any query to a BigQuery table — Porter handles the cron and the schema, so your dashboards and warehouse stay in sync.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and explore satellite imagery from top providers including Vantor, Planet, Airbus, and more, all in one place. payload.name: GSC SEO & Content Planner
payload.description: 分析 Search Console SEO 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Google Search Console to analyze finalized search performance, uncover keyword and content opportunities, compare ranking changes, and plan SEO articles using data from the SMEPost organizations you authorize. Access is read-only: the plugin cannot edit content, publish, or write to Google Search Console.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Google Search Console，分析已完成的搜索表现、发现关键词和内容机会、比较排名变化，并使用你授权的 SMEPost 组织数据规划 SEO 文章。访问权限为只读：插件无法编辑内容、发布内容或向 Google Search Console 写入数据。

payload.name: Brand & Market Social Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search recent public social posts for brand mentions, market demand, customer feedback, product needs, and emerging trends using keywords, language filters, and exclusions. Brand & Market Social Research is an independent Telemark Digital app. No external account, payment method, or purchase is required. Telemark Digital funds the free searches, subject to daily and shared monthly capacity limits.
payload.longDescription: 使用关键词、语言筛选条件和排除项，搜索近期公开社交帖子中的品牌提及、市场需求、客户反馈、产品需求和新兴趋势。每次请求都会执行有界的按需搜索，并返回精简 JSON。它不会访问私密帖子、按身份跟踪个人，也不会持续运行。Brand & Market Social Research 是 Telemark Digital 的独立应用。无需外部账户、付款方式或购买。Telemark Digital 资助免费搜索，但受每日和共享月度容量限制。

payload.name: Ramp Data
payload.description: 分析 Ramp 经济数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ramp Data MCP enables ChatGPT users to access Ramp Data from billions of dollars in real corporate spend across 50,000+ businesses, including Ramp Rate (vendor adoption, pricing, and switching trends) and the AI Index (how businesses are spending on AI). Ramp Data is used by founders, procurement leads, researchers, investors, and policy analysts and is cited by leading publications like NYT, WSJ, Bloomberg, and more.
payload.longDescription: Ramp Data MCP 让 ChatGPT 访问来自 50,000 多家企业、规模达数十亿美元的真实企业支出数据，包括 Ramp Rate（供应商采用、价格和更换趋势）及 AI Index（企业如何支出于 AI）。数据供创始人、采购负责人、研究人员、投资人和政策分析师使用，并被 NYT、WSJ、Bloomberg 等引用；结果用于研究和分析，不代表你的实际账户支出或财务建议。

payload.name: BigGeo AI
payload.description: 为大语言模型提供空间智能
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BigGeo AI brings spatial intelligence into your chat, allowing you to ask questions and get answers powered by real-world location data. Instead of searching through maps or raw data, simply ask and get clear, relevant answers about locations and how they relate.
payload.longDescription: BigGeo AI 将空间智能带入聊天，让你提问并获取由现实世界位置数据支持的答案。无需搜索地图或原始数据，只需提问，就能获得关于地点及其相互关系的清晰、相关答案。

payload.name: Leo - Running Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Leo is a running coach you talk to. Connect your Strava or Suunto account once, and Leo builds a periodized training plan around your goal race, then adapts it week after week based on your completed workouts and how you feel — no extra sensors needed.

Ask Leo to review your last run, adjust this week's sessions around your schedule, estimate your race time, or explain the reasoning behind a workout. Every recommendation is grounded in peer-reviewed sports science, and Leo remembers your training history, so its coaching stays consistent over time.

Requires a Coach Leo account (coachleo.ai). Your training data stays in your account and is only used to coach you.
payload.longDescription:
Leo 是一位可以通过对话交流的跑步教练。只需连接一次 Strava 或 Suunto 账户，Leo 就会围绕你的目标赛事制定周期化训练计划，并根据每周完成的训练和身体感受进行调整——无需额外传感器。

你可以让 Leo 回顾最近一次跑步、根据日程调整本周训练、估算比赛用时，或解释某项训练的设计原因。每项建议都以经过同行评审的运动科学为依据；Leo 会记住你的训练历史，确保长期指导保持连贯。

需要 Coach Leo 账户（coachleo.ai）。你的训练数据保存在自己的账户中，仅用于指导训练。

payload.name: Minter.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Minter.io helps users inspect connected social media reports, discover available analytics metrics, and query report data from Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Threads through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Minter.io 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看已连接的社交媒体报告、了解可用的分析指标，并查询 Instagram、TikTok、X、Facebook、LinkedIn 和 Threads 的报告数据。

payload.name: Omni
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Omni lets users work with their organization's governed business intelligence data from ChatGPT. The app can list available Omni models, select the best topic for a question, generate and run a single analytical query, start Omni's full AI assistant for deeper multi-step analysis, check the assistant job status, and search Omni documentation.
payload.longDescription: Omni 让用户在 ChatGPT 中使用组织受治理的商业智能数据。应用可以列出可用的 Omni 模型，为问题选择最佳主题，生成并运行单个分析查询，启动 Omni 完整 AI 助手进行更深入的多步分析，查看助手任务状态，并搜索 Omni 文档。

payload.name: Amplitude EU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Amplitude workspace to search charts and dashboards, query metrics and experiment results, explore events and properties, and create or update charts, dashboards, and alerts — without leaving the conversation. Amplitude is the product intelligence platform teams use to understand user behavior, measure impact, and decide what to build next.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Amplitude 工作区，无需离开对话，即可搜索图表和仪表板、查询指标和实验结果、探索事件和属性，以及创建或更新图表、仪表板和警报。Amplitude 是团队用于理解用户行为、衡量影响并决定下一步构建什么的产品智能平台。

payload.name: Sixtyfour Intelligence
payload.description: 用于情报分析的 AI 智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Deploy AI agents that investigate people and companies, resolve identities, map relationships, and surface risk signals — all through a single API.
payload.longDescription: 通过单一 API 部署 AI 智能体，用于调查个人和公司、确认身份、绘制关系网络并发现风险信号。

payload.name: Atlan
payload.description: 为 AI 提供企业上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Atlan is the context layer for enterprise AI. Connect ChatGPT to your organisation's context repos: the knowledge, data, and semantics your AI agents need to answer accurately. Use Atlan's agent skills to search and discover enterprise context, traverse end-to-end lineage, access governed data definitions and glossaries, execute SQL, curate your metadata graph, and ensure data quality, so every question you ask ChatGPT is grounded in trusted organisational context.
payload.longDescription: Atlan 是企业 AI 的上下文层。将 ChatGPT 连接至组织的上下文库，获取 AI 智能体准确回答所需的知识、数据和语义。使用 Atlan 的智能体技能搜索和发现企业上下文、追踪端到端数据血缘、访问受治理的数据定义和术语表、执行 SQL、维护元数据图谱，以及确保数据质量，让你向 ChatGPT 提出的每个问题都以可信的组织上下文为依据。

payload.name: JoomPulse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JoomPulse gives you instant access to MercadoLivre Brazil's marketplace data through natural language queries. Analyze product listings, categories, sellers, pricing trends, reviews, and keywords — all powered by a structured data warehouse. Whether you're doing competitive research, category analysis, or tracking listing performance, JoomPulse translates your questions into precise data insights without writing a single line of SQL. Built for e-commerce teams and analysts who need fast, reliable answers from Brazil's largest online marketplace.
payload.longDescription: JoomPulse 通过自然语言即时访问 MercadoLivre 巴西市场数据。分析商品列表、类别、卖家、价格趋势、评价和关键词，所有结果来自结构化数据仓库。适合竞争研究、类别分析和挂牌表现跟踪，无需编写 SQL。

payload.name: Book Report
payload.description: 分析你的作者销售数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Book Report imports and organizes your sales data from Kindle Direct Publishing, Draft2Digital, and many more leading book publishing platforms. With this app, you can give ChatGPT access to that sales data. It can summarize trends, compare time periods, identify top books and series, break down earnings by distributor or marketplace, answer follow-up questions, and much more. Instead of clicking around to find the data you need, you can get it simply by asking. Access is read-only: the app can retrieve reports and catalog context, but cannot modify Book Report data, accounts, or connected publishing accounts.
payload.longDescription: Book Report 从 Kindle Direct Publishing、Draft2Digital 及许多其他领先图书出版平台导入并整理销售数据。通过这款应用，你可以让 ChatGPT 访问这些销售数据。它可以汇总趋势、比较不同时段、找出最畅销的图书和系列、按发行商或市场细分收入、回答追问，以及更多用途。无需四处点击寻找数据，只要提问就能获取。访问仅限只读：应用可以检索报告和目录背景信息，但不能修改 Book Report 数据、账号或连接的出版账号。

payload.name: ChartMogul
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChartMogul’s MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your subscription analytics and customer data. Analyze MRR, ARR, churn, retention, cohorts, subscriptions, revenue trends, and customer activity using natural language. Investigate business performance, identify growth opportunities, uncover churn drivers, explore customer relationships, and answer complex questions about your SaaS business. Built for founders and go-to-market, product, and finance teams, it turns ChartMogul data into actionable insights and faster decisions.
payload.longDescription: ChartMogul 的 MCP 服务器让 AI 助手安全访问您的订阅分析和客户数据。使用自然语言分析 MRR、ARR、流失、留存、群组、订阅、收入趋势和客户活动。调查业务表现、发现增长机会、找出流失驱动因素、探索客户关系，并回答有关 SaaS 业务的复杂问题。它面向创始人以及市场进入、产品和财务团队，将 ChartMogul 数据转化为可执行洞察和更快决策。

payload.name: Deepnote
payload.description: 让智能体运行数据工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your Deepnote workspace into Codex. Search your workspace, trigger analytical workflows across 60+ data connectors, and use the output in Codex. No SQL, R, or Python knowledge required with the help of OpenAI models.

With Deepnote MCP, you can:

- Search across your projects, notebooks, and integrations
- Run an end-to-end notebook
- Pull the latest result from the notebook runs
- See scheduled runs in the workspace

All this while respecting your Deepnote workspace’s permissions. Note: this MCP requires an active Deepnote account and a Deepnote API token (https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api).
payload.longDescription:
将 Deepnote 工作区引入 Codex。搜索工作区、通过 60+ 个数据连接器触发分析工作流，并在 Codex 中使用输出结果。在 OpenAI 模型的帮助下，无需掌握 SQL、R 或 Python。

借助 Deepnote MCP，你可以：

- 搜索项目、笔记本和集成
- 运行端到端笔记本
- 获取笔记本运行产生的最新结果
- 查看工作区中的计划运行

所有这些操作都会遵循你的 Deepnote 工作区权限。注意：此 MCP 需要有效的 Deepnote 账户和 Deepnote API 令牌 (https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api)。

payload.name: PagePulse
payload.description: 跟踪 SEO 和页面变化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PagePulse brings your Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 metrics, and detected on-page change history into ChatGPT. Ask about your sites by project, page, or topic and get answers grounded in your actual analytics.
The unique angle is correlation. PagePulse tracks every detected change to your pages — title rewrites, content updates, schema edits, link changes — and scores each one by importance. So when you ask "why did traffic drop on the pricing page last week?", ChatGPT can pull the analytics, surface the relevant page changes, and show you which edits lined up with the shift.
Use it to investigate traffic dips, audit what's been changing across your site, find the queries driving impressions to a specific page, browse pages by tag, or get a quick read on how a project is performing — without switching between dashboards.
payload.longDescription:
PagePulse 将 Google Search Console 数据、Google Analytics 4 指标和检测到的页面变化历史带入 ChatGPT。按项目、页面或主题询问网站，获得基于真实分析数据的答案。
其独特之处在于关联分析。PagePulse 会跟踪检测到的每次页面变化，包括标题重写、内容更新、结构化数据编辑和链接变化，并按重要性评分。因此，当你问“为什么上周定价页流量下降？”时，ChatGPT 可以提取分析数据，找出相关页面变化，并显示哪些编辑与变化时间相吻合。
用于调查流量下降、审计网站变化、查找为特定页面带来展示的查询、按标签浏览页面，或快速了解项目表现，无需在仪表板之间切换。

payload.name: InsightfulPipe
payload.description: 使用 Google Ads、Meta 和 TikTok
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
InsightfulPipe is a marketing workspace that connects ChatGPT to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social media, and e-commerce platforms your business already uses. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, create reports, and perform supported actions without manually exporting and combining spreadsheets.

Paid advertising: Connect Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, and X Ads. Analyze spend, campaign performance, conversions, and other available metrics. You can also conduct competitor research using supported public advertising libraries.

SEO and site health: Access Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and DataForSEO for search performance, SERPs, keyword rankings, and backlinks. Additional tools include website crawling, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Tag Manager.

Analytics: Retrieve insights from Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, and YouTube Analytics.

Social media and scheduling: Analyze connected Instagram accounts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages and profiles, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and WordPress. Supported connections can also schedule, publish, and reschedule content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, and Google Business Profile.

E-commerce and email: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp.

InsightfulPipe can combine information from normally separate platforms. For example, ask ChatGPT to compare advertising spend with website sessions, conversions, orders, and revenue across your authorized accounts.

You can also connect your own data sources, including BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, with per-connection read-only or full-access permissions. Other supported sources include Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, and Slack. Custom REST APIs can be connected using supported OpenAPI 3.x specifications.

Read and write capabilities are exposed separately. Read-only tools do not modify connected accounts, while write actions require the necessary permissions and user confirmation. All tools operate within the access granted through each connection.

An InsightfulPipe account with at least one authorized connection is required. Available platforms, data, and actions depend on the services connected by each user and the permissions they grant.
payload.longDescription:
InsightfulPipe 是一个营销工作区，将 ChatGPT 连接到企业已经使用的营销、分析、SEO、社交媒体和电商平台。用日常语言提问、获取实时数据、创建报告并执行支持的操作，无需手动导出和合并电子表格。

付费广告：连接 Google Ads、Meta Ads、Microsoft Ads、LinkedIn Ads、TikTok Ads、Pinterest Ads、Snapchat Ads 和 X Ads。分析支出、营销活动表现、转化及其他可用指标；还可使用支持的公开广告库开展竞争对手研究。

SEO 与网站健康：访问 Google Search Console、Bing Webmaster Tools 和 DataForSEO，了解搜索表现、SERP、关键词排名和反向链接。其他工具包括网站抓取、PageSpeed Insights 和 Google Tag Manager。

分析：从 Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity、CallRail 和 YouTube Analytics 获取洞察。

社交媒体与排期：分析已连接的 Instagram 账户、Facebook 页面、LinkedIn 页面和个人资料、TikTok、Pinterest、YouTube、Google Business Profile 和 WordPress。支持的连接还可在 Instagram、Facebook、LinkedIn、TikTok、Pinterest、YouTube、Threads 和 Google Business Profile 上排期、发布和重新排期内容。

电商与邮件：连接 Shopify、WooCommerce、Magento、Google Merchant Center、Klaviyo 和 Mailchimp。

InsightfulPipe 可以合并通常分散在不同平台的信息。例如，让 ChatGPT 在获授权账户中比较广告支出与网站会话、转化、订单和收入。

你还可以连接自己的数据源，包括 BigQuery、PostgreSQL、MySQL 和 SQL Server，并为每个连接设置只读或完全访问权限。其他受支持的数据源包括 Airtable、Notion、Google Sheets 和 Slack。可以使用受支持的 OpenAPI 3.x 规范连接自定义 REST API。

读写能力分开提供。只读工具不会修改已连接账户，而写入操作需要必要权限和用户确认。所有工具都在每个连接授予的访问范围内运行。

需要 InsightfulPipe 账户及至少一个已授权连接。可用平台、数据和操作取决于每位用户连接的服务及授予的权限。

payload.name: Polar Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ChatGPT into your data analyst. Ask questions about your Shopify store, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other channels in plain language. Get answers on ROAS, CAC, top-performing SKUs, profit margins, and more, all pulled from Polar’s semantic layer for accuracy. Supports multi-store setups and works with major ecommerce integrations, including TikTok Ads and Klaviyo.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 变成您的数据分析师。用日常语言询问 Shopify 商店、Meta Ads、Google Ads 和其他渠道的数据。获取 ROAS、CAC、表现最佳的 SKU、利润率等信息，所有数据均来自 Polar 语义层，以确保准确性。支持多店铺设置，并兼容 TikTok Ads 和 Klaviyo 等主流电商集成。

payload.name: Tenzo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tenzo connects ChatGPT to your restaurant data. Ask questions in plain English about sales, labour, covers, average check, item mix, customer reviews and manager logs across all your locations. The app reads the same metrics and dimensions you already see in your Tenzo dashboard, respects your existing user permissions and business access, and can save useful queries back as cards and dashboards in your Tenzo account.
payload.longDescription: Tenzo 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的餐厅数据。你可以用通俗的英语询问所有门店的销售额、人工、客流人数、平均消费、商品组合、顾客评价和经理日志。应用读取你在 Tenzo 仪表板中已能看到的相同指标和维度，遵循你现有的用户权限和业务访问权限，并可将有用的查询保存为卡片和仪表板，写回你的 Tenzo 账户。

payload.name: Tango MCP
payload.description: 统一的政府承包数据 MCP
payload.summaryOriginal: A unified MCP for govcon data

Tango is built by govcon experts and software developers who understand the pain of stitching together multiple government data sources. payload.name: Adobe CJA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics helps authorized users discover data views, dimensions, metrics, segments, date ranges, projects, and audiences; run ranked CJA reports; inspect component definitions; and create or update reusable CJA components and Workspace projects through ChatGPT. payload.longDescription: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics 帮助获授权的用户通过 ChatGPT 查找数据视图、维度、指标、细分群体、日期范围、项目和受众；运行排名式CJA报告；检查组件定义；以及创建或更新可复用的CJA组件和 Workspace 项目。它需要 Adobe IMS OAuth 及 Customer Journey Analytics 产品访问权限，工具调用会使用已登录用户的IMS组织、沙盒或产品上下文，以及CJA权限。

payload.name: Catchr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Catchr helps marketers and agencies work with their marketing data directly in ChatGPT. 
Ask questions about campaign performance, compare results across connected sources, and turn raw metrics into clear reporting insights for clients and teams.
payload.longDescription: Catchr 帮助营销人员和代理机构直接在 ChatGPT 中处理营销数据。询问营销活动表现、比较已连接来源的结果，并将原始指标转化为面向客户和团队的清晰报告洞察。

payload.name: Lytical
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lytical automatically captures website activity and turns it into useful insights so you can understand traffic, behavior, and trends without digging through analytics reports. It helps you quickly answer questions like what changed, why it changed, and what to do next.
payload.longDescription: Lytical 会自动采集网站活动并将其转化为实用洞察，帮助你了解流量、用户行为和趋势，无需费力翻查分析报告。它能帮你快速回答诸如发生了什么变化、变化原因以及接下来该做什么等问题。

payload.name: Syncly Social
payload.description: 追踪社交媒体上的品牌提及
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Syncly's social intelligence into ChatGPT and Codex. Search brand mentions across social, including video. Track sentiment and mention volume over time, surface top creators, keywords, and trends, and rank posts by performance to see what is working.
payload.longDescription: 将 Syncly 的社交媒体洞察引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。搜索社交平台上的品牌提及，包括视频内容。追踪情绪倾向和提及量的变化，发现热门创作者、关键词和趋势，并按表现为帖子排名，以了解哪些内容有效。

payload.name: Landstack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Landstack MCP connects your AI model directly to UK land, planning and development data. Search and analyse planning applications, read planning documents, review local and neighbourhood plans, explore site allocations and land availability assessments, and look up title ownership data — all without leaving your AI workflow. 

Whether you're evaluating a single site or working through hundreds, Landstack gives your model the context it needs to answer detailed questions about planning history, policy constraints and land ownership across England, Wales and Scotland.
payload.longDescription:
Landstack MCP 可将 AI 模型直接连接到英国土地、规划和开发数据。搜索规划申请、阅读规划文件、审阅地方及社区规划、查看地块分配和土地可用性评估，并查询产权所有权数据——全程无需离开 AI 工作流。

无论是评估单个地块，还是处理数百个地块，Landstack 都能为模型提供所需背景信息，以便回答有关英格兰、威尔士和苏格兰规划历史、政策限制及土地所有权的详细问题。

payload.name: Property Hazard MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hazard lookup for any US address — flood, wildfire, earthquake, and coastal-storm exposure in a single call, using public government data (Census, FEMA, USGS). No API key required.
payload.longDescription: 只需一次调用，即可查询美国任意地址面临的危险——包括洪水、野火、地震和沿海风暴暴露风险；数据来自 Census、FEMA 和 USGS 等政府公开数据源。无需 API 密钥。

payload.name: Kindora
payload.description: 社会公益领域资助方研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kindora gives nonprofits and researchers direct access to the philanthropic funding landscape. Search grantmakers by name, cause area, geography, size, or classification; review IRS 990 financial summaries and grant histories; find open foundation and government grant opportunities; analyze giving patterns; and browse philanthropy jobs. Results come from public filings, public funder websites, and Kindora's curated funder corpus. The submitted tools are free, read-only, and require no Kindora account.
payload.longDescription: Kindora 为非营利组织和研究人员直接提供慈善资助领域信息。按名称、事业领域、地理位置、规模或分类搜索资助机构；查看 IRS 990 财务摘要和资助历史；查找开放申请的基金会和政府资助机会；分析捐赠模式；并浏览慈善领域职位。结果来自公开申报资料、资助方官网和 Kindora 精选的资助方语料库。提交的工具免费、只读，无需 Kindora 账户。

payload.name: Improvado AI Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Improvado AI Agent helps users work with Improvado workspaces through ChatGPT: inspect workspaces, data sources, connections, extracts, loads, documents, dashboards, recipes, and Discovery API workflows; switch workspace context; query data; and create or update private workspace resources.
payload.longDescription: Improvado AI Agent 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用 Improvado 工作区：检查工作区、数据源、连接、提取、加载、文档、仪表板、配方和 Discovery API 工作流；切换工作区上下文；查询数据；以及创建或更新工作区私有资源。

payload.name: Reverse Contact
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reverse Contact turns an email address, a name, or a LinkedIn URL into a professional profile. Ask who is behind an email address, summarise a person and the company they work for, or search people and companies by job title, industry, headcount and location.

Cached lookups return instantly. Live tools start a fresh collection and run asynchronously, returning a task you poll until it completes. Every call costs credits from your Reverse Contact workspace, and checking your balance is free.

You need a Reverse Contact account to use this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
Reverse Contact 可将电子邮件地址、姓名或 LinkedIn URL 转换为职业档案。你可以询问某个电子邮件地址背后的人是谁、总结某个人及其任职公司，或按职位名称、行业、员工人数和地点搜索个人及公司。

缓存查询会即时返回结果。实时工具会启动新的数据收集并异步运行，返回一个任务供你轮询，直到任务完成。每次调用都会消耗 Reverse Contact 工作区的额度，查询余额免费。

使用此插件需要 Reverse Contact 账户。

payload.name: Airbyte Agent Engine
payload.description: 查询所有应用中的数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Query data from all your apps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to all your business apps through Airbyte Agent Engine, the data layer for AI agents. Query live data from CRMs, support platforms, payment systems, code repositories, and more. Airbyte's type-safe connectors let ChatGPT retrieve information, interact with external systems, and trigger actions across different systems. The built-in Context Store indexes your data for fast search without extra infrastructure. Airbyte handles secure OAuth and credential management, so users connect in one click. Works with Salesforce, GitHub, Zendesk, Gong, HubSpot, Stripe, and more.
payload.longDescription: 通过面向 AI 智能体的数据层 Airbyte Agent Engine，将 ChatGPT 连接到你的所有业务应用。查询来自 CRM、客服平台、支付系统、代码仓库等的实时数据。Airbyte 的类型安全连接器让 ChatGPT 能检索信息、与外部系统互动，并跨不同系统触发操作。内置 Context Store 对数据建立索引，实现快速搜索，无需额外基础设施。Airbyte 负责安全的 OAuth 和凭据管理，让用户一键连接。支持 Salesforce、GitHub、Zendesk、Gong、HubSpot、Stripe 等。

payload.name: Fr8Labs Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask your freight-forwarding data anything — shipments, revenue, costs, margins, P&L, and AR/AP ageing — in plain language, and turn answers into charts, dashboards, and scheduled email reports, straight from your Fr8Labs FMS. Every query is scoped to your own company's data: results are read from a tenant-isolated analytics warehouse, and reports email only to your own domain. Built for freight-forwarding operators and finance teams who want self-service analytics without writing SQL.
payload.longDescription: 用自然语言查询 Fr8Labs 货运转发数据，包括货运、收入、成本、利润、损益和应收应付账龄，并生成图表、仪表板和定时邮件报告。查询仅限公司隔离数据，邮件仅发到本公司域名。

payload.name: Master Metrics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Master Metrics connects marketing teams to more than 25+ data sources in one place. Pull performance data from Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Analytics, Shopify, WooCommerce, Tiendanube, Kommo and more than 25 data sources— without switching between platforms.

Designed for marketing teams managing multiple clients, Master Metrics is the most accessible and straightforward alternative for teams in Latin America and beyond. A free registered account is required. Sign up at mastermetrics.com
payload.longDescription:
Master Metrics 将 25 多个数据源连接到一处，服务营销团队。无需在平台之间切换，即可从 Google Ads、Meta Ads、TikTok Ads、Google Analytics、Shopify、WooCommerce、Tiendanube、Kommo 以及 25 多个数据源提取表现数据。

Master Metrics 专为管理多个客户的营销团队设计，是拉丁美洲及其他地区团队最易用、最直接的替代方案。需要免费注册账户。请在 mastermetrics.com 注册。

payload.name: PolicyNote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use the PolicyNote app to access structured policy and regulatory intelligence from around the world. Search legislation, regulatory actions, policy updates, and government activity across jurisdictions.

The app enables developers, analysts, and policy professionals to retrieve policy data programmatically and integrate it into internal tools, research workflows, dashboards, or monitoring systems. Queries return structured information about policy developments, government sources, and regulatory changes.

PolicyNote helps teams track public policy activity, build alerts, power analysis tools, and integrate government intelligence into their applications.
payload.longDescription:
使用 PolicyNote 应用访问来自世界各地的结构化政策和监管情报。搜索不同司法管辖区的法律、监管行动、政策更新和政府活动。

此应用使开发者、分析师和政策专业人士能够通过程序检索政策数据，并将其集成到内部工具、研究工作流、仪表板或监测系统中。查询会返回关于政策动态、政府来源和监管变更的结构化信息。

PolicyNote 帮助团队追踪公共政策动态、创建提醒、构建分析工具，并将政府情报集成到自己的应用程序中。

payload.name: Dataslayer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to the marketing and analytics data available in your Dataslayer account. Ask questions in natural language and retrieve data from platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, and more, using the accounts already connected to Dataslayer.

With the Dataslayer plugin, you can:

- Discover your available data sources and connected accounts
- Find the metrics and dimensions supported by each platform
- Retrieve campaign and performance data for specific accounts and date ranges

payload.name: ApartmentIQ

payload.name: Clics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze your website traffic, conversions, and visitor behavior with simple, cookieless, privacy-first analytics - directly from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用简单、无 Cookie、优先保护隐私的分析功能，分析网站流量、转化和访客行为。

payload.name: KrystalView
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: KrystalView helps users inspect real website behavior from ChatGPT. It can list recent visitor sessions, drill into session detail, summarize site stats, analyze scroll depth, show live visitors, explain anomalies, inspect funnels, report campaign attribution and ROAS, list browser errors, and retrieve recent analytics notifications.
payload.longDescription: KrystalView 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中查看真实的网站行为。它可以列出近期访客会话、深入查看会话详情、汇总网站统计数据、分析滚动深度、显示实时访客、解释异常、检查转化漏斗、报告营销活动归因和 ROAS、列出浏览器错误，以及检索近期分析通知。

payload.name: Evidence Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Evidence is an AI-powered BI tool for publishing reports using SQL and Markdown. This connector lets ChatGPT work with your organization's live data and published reports on your behalf - securely, and scoped to your own permissions.

After you connect your Evidence account, ChatGPT can:
- Browse table metadata
- Run read-only queries against data stored in Evidence
- Search your published reports by topic, metric, or term, and read a page's content or a structured summary of its queries and components
- Retrieve AI context stored in Evidence - so answers match how your organization reports
payload.longDescription:
Evidence 是一款使用 SQL 和 Markdown 发布报告的 AI 驱动型 BI 工具。此连接器可代表你安全地访问组织的实时数据和已发布报告，并遵循你的个人权限。

连接 Evidence 账户后，ChatGPT 可以：
- 浏览表元数据
- 对存储在 Evidence 中的数据运行只读查询
- 按主题、指标或词语搜索已发布报告，并读取页面内容或其中查询和组件的结构化摘要
- 检索存储在 Evidence 中的 AI 上下文，让回答符合组织的报告口径

payload.name: Temso

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Temso tracks your brand's visibility across AI assistants — share of voice, sentiment, which sources they cite, and recommended actions to improve. Connect Temso to ask about your AI-visibility data in natural language and pull live analytics straight into the chat.
payload.longDescription: Temso 可追踪你的品牌在各 AI 助手中的曝光度，包括声量份额、情绪倾向、引用来源以及改进建议。连接 Temso 后，即可用自然语言询问 AI 曝光数据，并将实时分析直接带入聊天。

payload.name: Windsock
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.
You can ask follow-up questions in plain language — how avionics, engine time since overhaul, damage history, or location affect value; how long similar aircraft typically take to sell; and how the broader segment is moving. Windsock also pulls FAA registry details, airworthiness directives, and airport-level information including current weather and fuel-price forecasts.
It's built for aircraft owners, buyers, sellers, brokers, and anyone who needs a defensible read on what an aircraft is worth and how its market is behaving. Estimates are model-generated for informational purposes and are not a certified appraisal.
payload.longDescription:
Windsock 估算通用航空飞机的市场价值，并提供支持该估值的市场数据。输入飞机的尾号（N-number），即可获得当前估算市场价值、可比飞机以及该品牌和型号近期价格趋势。
你可以用日常语言提出后续问题，例如航电设备、大修后的发动机使用时间、损伤记录或所在地如何影响价值；类似飞机通常需要多久售出；以及整个细分市场的走势。Windsock 还会调取 FAA 注册信息、适航指令和机场级信息，包括当前天气及燃油价格预测。
它面向飞机所有者、买家、卖家、经纪人，以及任何需要可靠了解飞机价值及市场走势的人。估值由模型生成，仅供参考，并非经过认证的评估。

payload.name: DMAP AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DMAP AI helps users analyze drought conditions for a selected location and time period. It returns SPI tables, drought severity events, wavelet scalogram summaries, and drought periodicity diagnostics using NASA POWER or ERA5 data. Copula and paid workflows are not included in this ChatGPT version.
payload.longDescription: DMAP AI 可帮助用户分析所选地点和时间段的干旱状况。它使用 NASA POWER 或 ERA5 数据，返回 SPI 表格、干旱严重程度事件、小波标度图摘要和干旱周期诊断。本 ChatGPT 版本不包含 Copula 和付费工作流。
